description: Hey, I'm a music maker. I create music for various media, including games, films, commercials, VTubers, and more. If you're interested in commissioning a piece or have any questions, feel free to reach out to me.

tos:
1. PAYMENT
A 50% non-refundable deposit is required to start work. The remaining 50% is due upon completion and before final files are delivered.

2. REVISIONS
Packages include the stated number of revisions. Additional revisions are charged at $25–40 per round depending on complexity.

3. COMMERCIAL / STREAMING RIGHTS
Personal use is included. Monetized content, YouTube, Spotify, etc. requires an additional license fee — please discuss before ordering.

4. PORTFOLIO RIGHTS
I retain the right to use the work in my portfolio / social media / showreel unless you explicitly request otherwise (extra fee may apply).

5. COMMUNICATION & INACTIVITY
Please stay responsive. Projects inactive for more than 30 days without communication may be cancelled without refund of deposit.

6. CANCELLATION
If you cancel after work has started, the deposit is non-refundable. Mid-project cancellation may require payment for work completed.

7. DELIVERY FORMAT
Standard delivery is WAV (48 kHz / 24-bit) + MP3. Other formats available on request.
